bench_setup = function() {
	set.seed(20261117)
	n = 200L
	X = cbind(treatment = rbinom(n, 1, 0.5), x1 = rnorm(n), x2 = rnorm(n))
	lat = 0.5 * X[, 1] + 0.3 * X[, 2] - 0.2 * X[, 3] + rlogis(n)
	y = as.numeric(cut(lat, stats::quantile(lat, c(0, 0.3, 0.6, 0.85, 1)), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE))
	list(X = X, y = y)
}

notes: Times one cold-start AC fit plus one CR fit (n=200, K=4, p=3, well-scaled covariates, so ordinal_fit_scaled passes X through unscaled) with lbfgs vs newton_raphson; returns the full c(alpha, beta) vectors. tol is not 10x the 1e-8 tol: the lbfgs side stops on LBFGSpp's relative f-decrease (delta=1e-8, past=1, _helper_functions_core.h:1343-1346), which at |f|~250 leaves parameter error of order 1e-4, so 2e-3 relative (floored at 1) is the defensible bound. Excludes the R6 warm-start plumbing; the first-fit cold start is what is timed.
